messages.content: Return exactly this string, without quotes or extra text: ALPHA17_BETA703_GAMMA29_DELTA11
Four players each choose A or B. A player earns 3 if their choice is unique and 1 otherwise. The choices are A, A, B, B. Return only the payoffs in player order as comma-separated integers.
Write only a Python function named clamp01 that returns 0.0 for values below zero, 1.0 for values above one, and float(value) otherwise.
Call record_probe exactly once with label mtp-parity and value 703. Do not answer in text.

comparison_granularity.decoded_content: exact UTF-8 bytes from returned content, without trim or normalization
comparison_granularity.decoded_reasoning_content: exact UTF-8 bytes only when returned; otherwise null
comparison_granularity.tool_calls: function name and exact argument-string bytes in original call order; ignore generated tool-call IDs
comparison_granularity.target_token_ids: compare only if actual API/receipt exposes them; text-only API does not
comparison_granularity.raw_sse: private provenance SHA, not target-token parity because SSE framing/IDs may vary

interpretation.stable_controls_and_equal_candidate: decoded-output parity observed; token-level losslessness unproven unless token IDs available
interpretation.control_repeats_differ: runtime nondeterminism confounded; do not attribute candidate difference to MTP or claim losslessness
interpretation.stable_controls_and_candidate_differs: decoded-output parity failed; record exact difference and block lossless claim
interpretation.arithmetic_or_tool_failure: substantive correctness regression independent of parity interpretation
interpretation.swap_oom_restart_memory_floor_failure: resource qualification failure independent of parity interpretation
